Dear {{first_name}},

The outdoors has a way of bringing people together. This month we’re sharing stories from people who make space for everyone on the trail, and a few of their favourite walks.

See you out there,
The Pathway team
Finding belonging outdoors: five walkers’ stories
Five walkers on what the outdoors means to them, and the trails they keep going back to.
“The trail gave me room to breathe. Nobody cared what I looked like, only whether I’d brought snacks.”

Ro Hart
Founder of a walking group
“Being outside makes me feel braver in the rest of my life. That’s why we bring other people along.”
